title: Summary: Running Programs
objective: Capture a program's output, run a program that exits with code 2, and print both results.
hint: First: $state = cmd /c echo ready. Second: cmd /c "exit 2" on its own line. Then two Write-Output lines, one with Output: and $state, and one with Exit code: and $LASTEXITCODE. Read the variable straight after the program that sets it.
